description: This file defines a registry and management class for prompts within the litellm framework, including dynamic discovery of prompt initializers from integrations, and in-memory storage and retrieval of prompt specifications and callbacks.

classes.name: InMemoryPromptRegistry
classes.description: Manages in-memory storage of prompt specifications and associated callbacks, and handles prompt initialization and retrieval.

methods.name: get_prompt_initializer_from_integrations
methods.description: Discovers prompt initializers from the integrations directory by importing modules and collecting registries.

methods.name: initialize_prompt
methods.description: Initializes a prompt, registers its callback, and stores it in memory.

methods.name: get_prompt_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a prompt specification from memory by its ID.

methods.name: get_prompt_callback_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a prompt callback from memory by its ID.
